_meta.description: Court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
jurisdictionNote: High Court for the State of Uttar Pradesh with principal bench at Prayagraj (Allahabad) and a permanent bench at Lucknow. Has original, appellate, and writ jurisdiction.
cause_title_format:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
{caseNomenclature}

{petitioner} ... APPLICANT(S)

VERSUS

{respondent} ... OPPOSITE PARTY(S)

party_designation.state: State of U.P. through Principal Secretary, Home Department, Lucknow

case_nomenclature.anticipatory_bail: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. _____ of {year}
case_nomenclature.regular_bail: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. _____ of {year}
case_nomenclature.criminal_writ: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. _____ of {year}
case_nomenclature.first_appeal: First Appeal From Order No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant shall ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {body_para_count} of the above application are true and correct to my knowledge and belief. No part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT

localRules: All petitions must be filed through an advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of UP.
Bail applications listed as 'Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. _____ of [YEAR]'.
Anticipatory bail under S.482 BNSS must be accompanied by a duly sworn affidavit.
Lucknow Bench has territorial jurisdiction over 12 specified districts.
Synopsis and list of dates are required for all criminal miscellaneous applications.
